name: dmg-end-field
author: SailStellar <190052366@qq.com>
description: Slim LTS 浏览器工作台与独立 Electron 桌面 Shell

scripts.dev: npm run version:web-manifest && npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run data:web-manifest && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3030
scripts.dev:e2e: npm run version:web-manifest && npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run data:web-manifest && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3040
scripts.test:agent-runtime: node --experimental-strip-types agent/runtime/kernel/testing/trace-schema.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/runtime/kernel/testing/golden-trace.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/runtime/kernel/provider/sse-parser.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/runtime/kernel/provider/retry-policy.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/runtime/kernel/provider/openai-compatible-driver.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/runtime/kernel/agent-loop.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/runtime/kernel/session/session-log.test.ts
scripts.test:agent-wave1: npm run test:agent-core && npm run test:agent-runtime && npm run test:agent-conversation && npm run test:agent-engine:def-runtime
scripts.test:agent-tools: node --experimental-strip-types agent/core/tools/operation-capability.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/core/tools/damage-report-operations.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/core/tools/loadout-fact-operations.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/core/tools/read-only-workbench.buff.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/core/tools/read-only-workbench.damage.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/core/tools/read-only-workbench.loadout.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/core/tools/interactive-workbench.contract.test.ts
scripts.test:agent-host: node --experimental-strip-types agent/host/approval-capability-signer.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/host/session-store.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/host/product-command-store.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/host/host-recovery.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/host/host.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/host/interactive-host.contract.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types agent/host/opencode-native-ui-gateway.test.ts && npm run test:agent-interop
scripts.test:regression: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e:lts-slimming
scripts.test:legacy-fill: npm run test:legacy-fill-core && npm run test:legacy-fill-repository && npm run test:legacy-fill-host && npm run smoke:legacy-fill-service && npm run test:legacy-fill-mcp && npm run test:legacy-fill-curated
scripts.build:web: npm run version:web-manifest && npm run data:web-manifest && vite build && node scripts/build-atomic-service-worker.mjs dist
scripts.build:local: npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run build:web && npm run legacy-fill-runtime:build && npm run agent-runtime:build
scripts.build:sites: node scripts/clean-sites-build.mjs && npm run version:web-manifest && npm run assets:web-prepare && npm run data:web-manifest && SITES_BUILD=1 vite build && node scripts/build-atomic-service-worker.mjs dist/client && node scripts/prune-sites-image-package.mjs
scripts.check: npm run version:web-check && npm run check:repo && npm run audit:dependencies && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:agent-core && npm run test:agent-runtime && npm run test:agent-conversation && npm run test:agent-engine:def-runtime && npm run test:agent-tools && npm run test:agent-host && npm run test:agent-harness && npm run test:agent-supervisor && npm run test:agent-engine:opencode && npm run smoke:timeline-bundle && npm run build:local && npm run check:offline-shell && npm run check:offline-workspace
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.electron:dev: npm run legacy-fill-runtime:build && npm run agent-runtime:build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,desktop "npm:dev" "npm:electron:dev:launch"
scripts.electron:smoke:packaged:mac: node scripts/desktop-electron-smoke.mjs --executable "release/mac-arm64/终末地伤害工作台.app/Contents/MacOS/终末地伤害工作台"
scripts.electron:check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:agent-core && npm run test:agent-runtime && npm run test:agent-conversation && npm run test:agent-engine:def-runtime && npm run test:agent-tools && npm run test:agent-host && npm run test:agent-harness && npm run test:agent-supervisor && npm run test:agent-engine:opencode && npm run test:legacy-fill && npm run electron:smoke:host && npm run electron:smoke:worker && npm run electron:smoke:data-release && npm run electron:smoke:image-release && npm run electron:smoke:boundaries && npm run build:local && npm run electron:smoke:app
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build:local && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 && npm run electron:smoke:package
scripts.electron:verify:mac: npm run electron:build:dir && npm run electron:smoke:package && npm run electron:smoke:agent-package && npm run electron:smoke:packaged:mac
